contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman pottery sherd from a vessel, a Samian decorated bowl dating to the second half of the 1st century by the potter Albucius. This bowl may be Dragendorff 37. There is a glossy dark red slip on both external and internal surfaces which is now heavily abraded.
